mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate directly increases the discount rate applied to equity valuations, compressing price-to-earnings ratios and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating, indicated by unemployment rate exceeding 4.0%, triggers a Federal Reserve tightening response that reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when both HOUST < 1350.0 and RSAFS < 700000.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 1300.0 (thousands of units) indicates a sharp slowdown in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production index below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when UNRATE is above its 5-year average.
